{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df["revenue"] = df["revenue"].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now check for QA orders using the numeric value 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders (numeric check): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Display the QA orders if any
qa_orders.head()"}
